entities.name: Coronin-7 (CORO7)
observations: The 768-aa query sequence matches reviewed rat Coronin-7 at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; human CORO7 match is 83.9% identity with 100% query coverage.

Reference annotations describe CORO7 as an F-actin regulator associated with Golgi/post-Golgi trafficking, trans-Golgi network localization, and promotion of actin polymerization; this functional assignment is transferred by homology.
Pfam hits include DUF1899 and multiple WD40-family regions.
Sequence-derived estimates: 83,341 Da molecular mass; pI 5.80; GRAVY −0.212. These are unmodified-sequence estimates.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; absence of a reaction annotation does not prove nonenzymatic function.
